title: FDA Clears Bracco-Avicenna Brain Aneurysm AI Detector
summary: UPTUNITY Aneurysm receives FDA 510(k) clearance for detecting saccular brain aneurysms >3mm on CT angiography with quantitative follow-up measurements.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Bracco and Avicenna.AI received FDA 510(k) clearance for UPTUNITY Aneurysm, detecting saccular brain aneurysms larger than 3mm on cerebral CT angiography scans.
- The AI system provides concurrent detection, location, size data, and quantitative follow-up measurements across prior exams to support clinical assessment workflows.
- With one in 50 U.S. adults harboring unruptured aneurysms, the tool addresses missed diagnoses in busy radiology environments starting November 2026.


Bracco and Avicenna.AI announced FDA 510(k) clearance for UPTUNITY Aneurysm, an AI-enabled clinical decision support system that detects suspected saccular brain aneurysms larger than 3mm on cerebral CT angiography scans. Officially launched on November 19, 2026, the software integrates directly into radiology workflows to assist medical specialists with concurrent detection and quantitative follow-up measurements. The clearance marks the first product in Bracco's UPTUNITY portfolio and expands the Milan-based company's digital health capabilities in interpretive AI.


## How the Detection System Works


UPTUNITY Aneurysm operates as computer-assisted detection and diagnosis (CAD/CADx) software designed for use by appropriately trained medical specialists. The system analyzes head CT angiography images to identify suspected saccular aneurysms, providing information on presence, anatomical location, and size to support clinical assessment and characterization. For patients with known aneurysms undergoing follow-up imaging, the software delivers quantitative measurements and automated comparisons between examinations to help physicians assess morphological changes over time.


The tool is designed for concurrent use alongside traditional image review, with physicians retaining full control over clinical decision-making. It is not intended to replace comprehensive patient evaluation or independent review by a qualified radiologist.


## Clinical Context and Unmet Need


Unruptured intracranial aneurysms affect an estimated one in 50 U.S. adults but remain frequently asymptomatic until rupture occurs. These lesions can be difficult to detect on routine head CT angiography, particularly in high-volume acute-care environments where radiologists face substantial caseloads and time pressure. Missed or delayed identification can affect patient management, follow-up imaging protocols, and intervention timing decisions.


- Approximately 2% of the U.S. adult population harbors an unruptured intracranial aneurysm
- Many aneurysms remain clinically silent until rupture, which carries significant morbidity and mortality
- Detection challenges increase in busy emergency and outpatient imaging workflows


The UPTUNITY system addresses these workflow bottlenecks by flagging suspected lesions in real time and providing structured quantitative data to support consistent follow-up protocols.


## Commercial Rollout and Distribution


Bracco and Avicenna.AI plan the U.S. commercial introduction of UPTUNITY Aneurysm following the November 2026 FDA clearance, with Avicenna.AI leading promotional activities and distribution. The solution will be showcased at the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA) 2026 Annual Meeting, scheduled for November 29 through December 3 in Chicago. The RSNA platform provides access to radiology decision-makers and imaging center administrators evaluating AI workflow tools.


The launch complements Bracco's existing contrast media and imaging portfolio while establishing the company's presence in AI-driven clinical decision support. Avicenna.AI, based in La Ciotat, France, specializes in medical imaging AI and brings domain expertise in radiology workflow integration.


## Regulatory Pathway and Clearance


The FDA granted 510(k) clearance for UPTUNITY Aneurysm, a premarket notification pathway that demonstrates substantial equivalence to existing legally marketed devices. The clearance permits marketing and distribution of the software as a Class II medical device for use in detecting and assessing brain aneurysms on cerebral CTA images. The regulatory authorization validates the system's safety and effectiveness profile for its intended use in clinical radiology environments.


## What This Means


The FDA clearance of UPTUNITY Aneurysm represents a targeted deployment of AI in a high-stakes diagnostic domain where missed findings carry serious clinical consequences. By embedding detection and quantitative follow-up capabilities directly into radiology reading workflows, the system addresses operational constraints that contribute to diagnostic errors in busy imaging centers. The commercial launch positions Bracco and Avicenna.AI to capture market share in radiology AI while establishing a foundation for the broader UPTUNITY portfolio. As hospitals and imaging networks evaluate AI tools for quality assurance and workflow optimization, real-world performance data from early adopters will determine whether UPTUNITY Aneurysm delivers measurable improvements in aneurysm detection rates and follow-up consistency.
